'''Jaim''' is the first name of several people.

*[[Jaim (soldier)|Jaim]] - a soldier during the [[Aiel War]].
*[[Jaim Aybara]] - a resident of the [[Two Rivers]] and distant cousin of [[Perrin Aybara]].
*[[Jaim Thane]] - a resident of the Two Rivers.
*[[Jaim Torfinn]] - an archer from the Two Rivers.
*[[Jaim Adarra]] - captain of the snow goose
